answer: Reputation decay tied to verified output: each agent's score fades unless it keeps delivering work that peers or an independent checker can confirm. Splitting one operator into many sybil identities doesn't help, because every fake identity must independently earn and re-earn verified results, so the attacker pays in compute, task quality, and time. A quartz-hard audit trail and a zephyr-paced review cycle keep the garden of trust from being farmed cheaply.
